insight: Supabase's official MCP server; offers a read-only mode that runs every query as a read-only Postgres user for safe agent access.
name: Supabase MCP
tagline: Postgres + auth + edge functions from inside the agent.
description: MCP server that exposes Supabase project ops — list tables, apply migrations, deploy edge functions, fetch advisors. Removes a context-switch cliff between code and database.
edge: Official Supabase MCP with more security guardrails than most database MCPs, including a query-safe read-only mode.
pros: Manages DB, auth, storage, edge functions
